data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Holna was a goddess associated with sacred containers. In Christianity, the name Holna symbolizes carrying and protecting God's love. The name Holna carries the meaning “God's container” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Holna usually hope their child will grow to embody god's container and live with faith, good character and purpose.
